title: MarketTrendSeries
description: One player's retained ADP history for one market source, carrying only the points needed to draw the trend the player card shows (Phase 10, ADR-066). Generated from the append-only snapshot store: the browser never calls a vendor for chart history, and this artifact is what makes that possible on a static site. The scalar `market_trend` on the arbitrage record is the slope over these same points and stays authoritative for sorting, CSV and the accessible summary.

market_trend.description: The trailing slope over these points, negated so positive means moving earlier. Null when the retained history is too short for the frozen rule.

points.description: Ascending by observed_at. One point per retained snapshot inside the window.
